description: Discover 1118 Newhall, a beautifully updated 1927 San Francisco home blending classic character with modern upgrades. This 2BD/1BA residence features a remodeled kitchen and bathroom, new flooring throughout, and updated electrical. Bright and inviting interior with a functional layout, including a living room with a welcoming fireplace that flows into a dedicated dining area with charming French doors at the entry.  The modern kitchen offers clean finishes, floating shelves, and an efficient layout. A versatile bonus room provides ideal space for a home office, gym, or creative use. Two well-sized bedrooms with ample closet storage plus hallway linen storage.  Major improvements include over $250,000 invested in upgrades, including a fully remodeled kitchen and bathroom main sewer and underground water line replacement, removal of knob-and-tube wiring, a new electrical system throughout with outlets, switches, subpanel, and dedicated circuits, full interior demo with new flooring, furnace replacement, full exterior paint, and plaster wall smoothing and refinishing.  Spacious garage fits up to 3 cars tandem, includes a laundry area, and offers  potential for expansion or possible ADU (buyer to verify with City). Private backyard with room for outdoor seating, entertaining, or gardening.  Conveniently located near neighborhood favorites like All Good Pizza, Tato's, and Smoke Soul Kitchen, and just blocks to the Muni T Third Street Line for easy access to Downtown, Mission Bay, UCSF, Oracle Park, and Chase Center. Close to shopping, cafes, and everyday conveniences.
